note: Estimates, not measurements. Where runs/estimate-fit/params.js has fitted parameters for the game/tier (fitted to committed real-model runs; hold-out error tables in runs/estimate-fit/fit-report.md): low calls = the fitted mean agent actions per episode, high calls = the tier's maxActions budget, tokens per call = the fitted means/maxima of the runs' recorded provider usage. Unfitted tiers: low calls = the game engine/greedy baseline's mean agent actions on two seeds of the tier, or the episode par where no baseline exists; tokens per call = the official system prompt plus the per-turn official user message (harness/official.js) rendered along the baseline episode at 4 characters per token. Real runs may cost more. Probe episodes were skipped (--no-probes): the low side comes from the fit where fitted, else the tier's par; tiers with neither are unestimated.
